data.standardized_narrative: Using the gross claims development table, underwriting years prior to 2022 (notably 2021) show adverse development resulting in a gross strengthening of approximately 5.647 million (USD) on prior years, equivalent to about 10.6% of the opening gross claims outstanding. The movement appears attributable to adverse claims development on older underwriting years, together with inflationary pressure and recalibration of IBNR assumptions. The Syndicate's casualty/third-party liability portfolio is the principal exposure likely to be affected given its predominance in the premium mix.
raw_causal_phrases: The rapidly changing environment in the cyber class of business has a higher degree of uncertainty due to the propensity for changes to the cyber risk landscape and perils, such as ransomware emerging in the past couple of years.
Loss estimates are heavily influenced by expected loss ratios on which there is a high level of uncertainty.

There are a number of factors which impact the inflationary environment; such as government or central bank actions, movements in exchange rates impacting the cost of imports, and geopolitical factors such as those already noted above.
The provision for claims outstanding comprises the estimated cost of settling all claims incurred but unpaid at the balance sheet date, whether reported or not.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from balance sheet (Claims outstanding: 2022 comparative). Prior-year development is derived from the gross claims development table (triangle) by comparing the current estimate to the previous diagonal for underwriting years <=2021; triangle is limited (only 2021 is an 'older' year) so the PYD figure (5.647m) is based on a single underwriting year column. No explicit 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure was found in the narrative. All monetary figures are in the report's native currency (USD) though some field names use '_gbp_m' per schema; amounts are expressed in millions of USD. Confidence reflects derivation from the triangle rather than an explicit gross prior-year movement note.
